==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Cara:''' Good clarity. But the color is not attractive enough...
:{{DIcon}} What are you looking at?
:'''Cara:''' Huh? What do you think of this Vitreum Dancer's quality?
:{{DIcon}} Does an Echo have quality?
:'''Cara:''' Of course. When it comes to Vitreum Dancers, you can look at the cut of the glass and the gilding...
:'''Cara:''' Especially for stained glass they are made of, it varies greatly in color, purity, and texture between different specimens.
:'''Cara:''' The finer the materials, the higher the value of the Vitreum Dancers.
:'''Cara:''' That said... there's still no complete valuation system in place.
